column1: #build label(surface_farm_plots) start(1; 1) message(Place on dug-out soil or muddied stone. Two 3x3 farm plots flank a paved road that haulers use to reach both. Set each plot's crops in the farming screen after Quickfort builds them.)
title: Twin farm plots with a hauling road
tags: build, farm, farm plot, road, food, starter
description: Two 3x3 farm plots joined by a paved road for early food production. Each plot is written as p{seasonal_fertilize=true}(3x3): the p token is a farm plot
column2: the {seasonal_fertilize=true} property tells the plot to fertilize itself every season
column3: and the (3x3) extent fills the whole plot from its anchor cell down and to the right
column4: so you only paint one tile per plot. The o tokens along the bottom lay a paved road so haulers cross the plots quickly; O would lay a dirt road instead (no stone needed
column5: slower to build). Farm plots need a floor of soil or mud-covered stone
column6: so dig out the area first (or run a muddying blueprint) before you build. After Quickfort places the plots
column7: open each in the farming screen to pick which crop grows in each season.
